title.narrative: Ratification of Conventions and UNESCO Recommendation in Education: The Case of Malawi

description.narrative: The project is aimed to raise awareness for Malawi to ratify the Conventions and UNESCO Recommendations. To achieve its objectives to raise awareness of the UNESCO Conventions to the education stakeholders in Malawi, to prepare the ratification or accession instrument for Malawi, and to deposit the ratification or accession instrument for Malawi to UNESCO. The project will carry out consultative meetings which will provide the opportunity for education stakeholders, legal experts and high-level officials to scrutinize the Conventions and weigh its implications to Malawi and their compatibility with Malawi’s laws and education aspirations, ultimately deposit its ratification instrument to UNESCO.
